# PolarPlot

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Magnitude and angle data sets on polar axes (SPEC-002).

![PolarPlot, light theme](../img/widgets/polar-plot-light.png#only-light){ width="228" }
![PolarPlot, dark theme](../img/widgets/polar-plot-dark.png#only-dark){ width="228" }

**Graphs, specialized** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.PolarPlot) ·
schema [`polar.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
theta = np.arange(0, 361, 5)
r = np.abs(np.cos(np.radians(theta))) ** 3
ai.PolarPlot(
    value=[{"name": "pattern", "r": r.tolist(), "theta": theta.tolist()}],
    label="PolarPlot",
    size=(220, 220),
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | array of object | `[]` | host | Data sets {name, color, style, r, theta}; r and theta have the same length. |
| `angle_unit` | `"deg"`, `"rad"` | `"deg"` | host |  |
| `zero` | `"E"`, `"N"` | `"E"` | host | Where angle 0 is: east (mathematical) or north (compass). |
| `direction` | `"ccw"`, `"cw"` | `"ccw"` | host | Positive sense of the angles. |
| `r_max` | number or null | `null` | host, widget | Radial range; null or not positive: scaled to the data. Set by the operator with the mouse wheel or the r max field (CHART-108). |
| `rings` | integer | `4` | host | Approximate number of grid rings. |
| `unit` | string | `""` | host |  |
